name: Galaxy Fox claim contract unprotected setMerkleRoot
summary: The unverified GFOX airdrop/claim contract's setMerkleRoot(bytes32) writes the Merkle root to storage slot 3 without any caller check. The attacker set a root equal to its own leaf and called claim with an empty proof, withdrawing 1.34B GFOX and selling it into the GFOX/WETH Uniswap V2 pair; three copycat transactions by two other actors repeated the same calls within about two hours and emptied the contract.

loss.notes: The claim contract's entire GFOX balance (1,780,453,099.185 GFOX) was taken in four transactions: the anchor (1,335,339,824.38875), copycat bot 0xcc3a5dc003b3a58621745a39f706ef9646d5c481 in source-6 and source-7 (333,834,956.0971875 and 83,458,739.024296875) and 0x14b362d2e38250604f21a334d71c13e2ed478467 in source-8 (27,819,579.674765625, sold in source-9). GFOX is valued by realised proceeds: the GFOX/WETH pair 0x92ee0df7f6b0674cabc9bfc64873786fa7be82d0 paid out 108.744009594558929771 + 5.081096386975926775 + 1.344190519511096579 + 2.329061044327335573 = 117.498357545373288698 WETH for the dumped tokens, valued at the WETH quote at the anchor time (3035.7 USD; all legs within 2h16m). Token transfer tax taken from the stolen GFOX is not counted, so this is a lower bound.

ageReset.description: Immutable claim runtime has an unguarded setMerkleRoot; owner root updates and funding do not introduce the missing check.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age history. The claim contract 0x11a4a5733237082a6c08772927ce0a2b5f8a86b6 is unverified; cast disassemble of its runtime (eth_getCode) dispatches selector 0x7cb64759 (setMerkleRoot(bytes32)) to pc 0x17f, which ABI-decodes one word and executes PUSH1 0x03 SSTORE with no CALLER/owner comparison, whereas setClaimStart 0xb0aa1e04 jumps to an internal routine at 0x054e. The runtime has no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 19835925, index 0): attacker EOA 0xfce19f8f823759b5867ef9a5055a376f20c5e454 calls its executor 0x86c68d9e13d8d6a70b6423ceb2aedb19b59f2aa5, which CREATE2s 0x47c4b3144de2c87a458d510c0c0911d1903d1686; that contract calls setMerkleRoot(0xe8236ea3d247bd0c85596d7bb707f40ca374a6fa58d66ece1d80cdc2ac7ecbaf) then claim(0x47c4b314..., 1335339824388750000000000000, []) (0x3d13f874), receives the GFOX, and swaps it on UniswapV2Router02 for WETH. eth_call merkleRoot() (0x2eb4a7ab): 0xa1f89bcc4981b41883f84abcef1e8b44bc9d000f59abc86870892fda105d0aba at block 19835924 and 0xe8236ea3... at 19835925; owner() is 0x4e6647a2bda8dfe75316a72e73586ecd24d0e700 at both, so the caller was not the owner. Earliest-use scan: Etherscan V2 account.txlist of the claim contract (blocks 0..99999999, 7643 txs) shows setMerkleRoot only from the owner (blocks 19686241, 19735662, 19765697, 19834514); merkleRoot() read one block before and at each owner call equals the previous and the newly set owner root (0 -> 0x0d14456f... -> 0x1c28d9ef... -> 0x7747ef2d... -> 0xa1f89bcc...), and the pre-exploit root equals the last owner root, so no earlier non-owner root persisted. GFOX Transfer logs from the contract after the exploit are only source-1 and the three copycat transactions. Identity/age: eth_getCode empty at block 19685995; keccak256 of runtime 0xc6c2246c81477a242a46c84758cf0c050352cad9c9939f63aa8f5e750f095aba at deployment block 19685996 and pre-exploit block 19835924. source-10 is a top-level creation (index 114) by 0x1dbc852b34566d7cd741e86908d7027e58c7d9ab. Owner root updates and setClaimStart only configure the legitimate airdrop and are not necessary to the missing check; deployment supplies the age. DeFiHackLabs PoC source-11 forks block 19835924 and calls setMerkleRoot then claim on 0x11a4a573...; its header mislabels the attacker's CREATE2 contract 0x47c4b3144de2c87a458d510c0c0911d1903d1686 as the vulnerable contract.

Reviewed gross loss from receipts. GFOX 0x8f1cece048cade6b8a05dfa2f90ee4025f4f2662 (decimals 18) balanceOf(claim contract) is 1780453099185000000000000000 at block 19835924, 445113274796250000000000000 at 19835925 and 0 from block 19836508. eth_getLogs Transfer(from=claim contract), blocks 19835925..21200000, returns four transfers: source-1 1335339824388750000000000000; source-6 (block 19836009, index 0) 333834956097187500000000000 and source-7 (block 19836010, index 0) 83458739024296875000000000, both by 0xcc3a5dc003b3a58621745a39f706ef9646d5c481 through 0xb22a26c6da22cc4686560a45469bf1654bf4f3cd, each calling setMerkleRoot then claim from a freshly created contract; source-8 (block 19836507, index 3) 27819579674765625000000000 by 0x14b362d2e38250604f21a334d71c13e2ed478467 via 0x347ed8eae1fb74767d894dca327c92c2ec4b7287 with the same two calls. WETH Transfer net of pair 0x92ee0df7f6b0674cabc9bfc64873786fa7be82d0 in the dump transactions: source-1 -108744009594558929771, source-6 -5081096386975926775, source-7 -1344190519511096579, source-9 (block 19836600, index 103; 0x14b362d2... sells via Universal Router) -2329061044327335573; total 117.498357545373288698 WETH. Valued at DefiLlama WETH 3035.7 USD at 1715299187 (source-5): 356,689.76 USD, consistent with SlowMist/BlockSec's about 300,000-330,000 USD.
